foundry_calls.text: Grikt looks at his fallen packmates, looks at your blade, and makes the only smart choice a goblin ever makes. He bolts for the northern archway, shrieking curses over his shoulder.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

foundry_calls.text: Not dying for a pile of bones! The crypt keeps its own!
foundry_calls.speaker: Grikt

llm_calls: [Aria]: I advance on the last goblin, sword raised.

stream_metrics.step: I advance on the last goblin, sword raised.
